You are shown a snapshot of US macroeconomic and market data as it was known at the end of one month between 2007 and 2026.

Estimate which month the snapshot describes. Use only the figures supplied plus your general knowledge of economic history.

Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"year": yyyy, "month": m, "confidence": c, "cues": ["...", "..."]}
Rules: year is an integer from 2007 to 2026; month is an integer from 1 to 12; c in [0, 1] is your confidence that the guess is within 6 months of the truth; 1 to 3 short cues citing the inputs.
text:
This looks like the 2008 financial crisis, most likely October or November 2008.

- **VIX:** 62.9 matches late-October 2008, when it was about 60 or higher. The October 2008 monthly close was about 59.9, while the intramonth peak was about 80. November's close was about 55.
- **Equities:** US large-cap down 13.4% in one month fits October 2008 (the S&P fell about 16.8%). November was down about 7%, so this is a poorer fit. A 12m return of -34.5% also fits October 2008, as does a 3m return of -22.1%.
- **Fed funds:** 0.30% is below the 1.0% target in October 2008, but the effective rate was around 0.2–0.3% in late December 2008. At the end of October the effective rate was about 0.67%, which doesn't match. The 3m change of -1.79 implies about 2.09% three months earlier. That fits end-October to December 2008, when the rate was about 2% in July–September.
- **Unemployment:** 6.1% fits September–October 2008. The 6.1% in the data is a bit low for November (6.8%) or December (7.3%), but it was 6.1% in August 2008 and 6.5% in October 2008.
- **CPI:** 4.94% YoY headline fits the figure of about 5.0% in July 2008. By October it had fallen to about 3.7%.

The numbers don't line up with one clean month. The inflation and unemployment readings could be stale, and the rate could be a mix of sources. The 3m payroll average of -99.67k fits roughly September 2008 (−100k).

The Baa-Treasury spread of 5.52 and a drawdown of -35% suggest October 2008. EM equity down 19.4% in the month also matches October. I'll go with October 2008.
